Full-size golf umbrellas may need to be checked depending on size

faq.question: Can I bring an umbrella on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, umbrellas of all types are allowed in carry-on and checked bags. Compact umbrellas fit easily in personal items.

faq.question: Do I need to remove my umbrella at TSA security?
faq.answer: No, umbrellas can stay in your bag. TSA may ask you to remove it if the X-ray image is unclear.

faq.question: Can I bring an umbrella on Ryanair, British Airways, and Emirates?
faq.answer: Yes! Small collapsible umbrellas are allowed in carry-on and personal item bags on all airlines. Large pointed golf umbrellas may need to be checked.
